name: Condicionais
summaryPt: Estruturas if para situações reais, hipotéticas e passadas.

meaningUses.en: If you heat water, it boils.
meaningUses.enPt: Se você aquece a água, ela ferve.

meaningUses.en: If it rains, I'll stay home.
meaningUses.enPt: Se chover, vou ficar em casa.

meaningUses.en: If I had money, I would travel.
If I had studied, I would have passed.
meaningUses.enPt: Se eu tivesse estudado, teria passado.

formation.pt: If + past perfect, would have + particípio.
formation.pattern: If I had studied, I would have passed.

examples.en: If I had studied, I would have passed.
examples.pt: Se eu tivesse estudado, teria passado.

subjectAgreement.pt: No zero/first, o verbo na cláusula if concorda normalmente (3ª pessoa -s).
No second, todas as pessoas usam was/were ou o passado simples.
subjectAgreement.example: If I were rich, I would help. (were formal)

commonErrors.pt: Usar will dentro da cláusula if (first)
commonErrors.wrong: If it will rain, I'll stay home.
commonErrors.right: If it rains, I'll stay home.

commonErrors.pt: Usar would dentro da cláusula if (second)
commonErrors.wrong: If I would have money, I would travel.
commonErrors.right: If I had money, I would travel.

commonErrors.pt: Trocar as formas do second e third
commonErrors.wrong: If I studied, I would have passed.
commonErrors.right: If I had studied, I would have passed.

contrast.pt: Third conditional usa past perfect na cláusula if.
contrast.en: If I had studied, I would have passed.
contrast.enPt: Se eu tivesse estudado, teria passado.
